name: Murmurleaf Paths
introDiscord:
The current from Starfall Trench slips beneath towering silver kelp,
where every leaf seems to whisper to the next. Tiny Murmurleaf Minnows
dart between the roots, carrying scraps of overheard sound deeper into
the forest. Somewhere ahead, something repeats your arrival.
introTwitch:
The current from Starfall Trench slips beneath towering silver kelp,
where every leaf seems to whisper to the next. Tiny Murmurleaf Minnows
dart between the roots, carrying scraps of overheard sound deeper into
the forest. Somewhere ahead, something repeats your arrival.

murmurleaf-paths-approach.prompt:
Towering murmurleaf columns sway over three paths. Every rustle passes
from leaf to leaf until the whole forest seems to be quietly discussing
you.

left.message:
A tiny voice somewhere in the kelp whispers, 'Traveler.'

Another answers, 'Traveler.'

A dozen leaves repeat it.

Then a Murmurleaf Minnow shoots from the fronds, apparently appointed
to investigate the rumor personally.

right.message:
Inside a living root, you discover an offering basket wrapped in broad
leaves. Several Minnows hover nearby whispering excited bubbles at one
another as you recover the Star Candies.

forward.message:
A folded leaf cradles restorative sap beside one of Shizuki's crooked
trail marks. She wrote:

'Forest keeps repeating everything I say.

Testing important phrase:

BERRIES ARE IMPORTANT.'

The distant kelp softly whispers, 'berries are important.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
The restorative sap remains folded safely inside the leaf. You're
already healthy, and the forest is still busy preserving Shizuki's
extremely important berry announcement.

murmurleaf-paths-depths.prompt:
Living rootways twist deeper beneath drifting Fae lights. The whispers
have grown clearer, and three routes now seem to be repeating different
conversations.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp has been folded into a surprisingly neat parcel.
Inside are Star Candies and a tiny leaf-tag reading:

'FOUND IT!'

A second leaf nearby whispers, 'lost it.'

right.message:
Several Minnows gather around a root and mimic a perfect little melody.

You stop to listen.

The song ends.

Every Minnow turns toward you at once.

Apparently the next verse is combat.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's doodled forest map.

Most of the paths are unlabeled.

One says:

'THIS TREE CALLED ME LOST.'

Below it, in smaller writing:

'It was correct. Still rude.'

murmurleaf-paths-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds curl around forgotten shrines as three final routes
approach Choirleaf Clearing. The murmur has become a coordinated chorus.

left.message:
A tranquil moonblossom pool rests beneath woven roots. Shizuki left a
note beside the restorative water:

'Very peaceful.

Do NOT loudly ask the forest whether you're lost.

It WILL answer.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the moonblossom pool undisturbed. You're already healthy,
and there is no need to invite further commentary from the vegetation.

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer opens beneath a canopy of whispering
leaves. Inside are Star Candies. The leaves immediately begin telling
the rest of the forest what you found.

forward.message:
The whispers stop.

A single Murmurleaf Minnow darts into the path.

Behind it, dozens of tiny voices chant in perfect rhythm.

It has backup singers.

boss-antechamber.name: Choirleaf Clearing
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The clearing ahead is ringed by thousands of leaves, each murmuring a
different note until the whole grove becomes one enormous underwater
choir.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every Murmurleaf Minnow gathers along the roots of Choirleaf Clearing.

Their scattered whispers suddenly align into one perfect harmony.

Something much larger moves behind the curtain of leaves, and the entire
school falls silent for it.

Use /yes to enter Choirleaf Clearing or /no to leave the forest choir
waiting for its audience.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every Murmurleaf Minnow gathers along the roots of Choirleaf Clearing.

Their scattered whispers suddenly align into one perfect harmony.

Something much larger moves behind the curtain of leaves, and the entire
school falls silent for it.

Use !yes to enter Choirleaf Clearing or !no to leave the forest choir
waiting for its audience.
bossRetreatText:
You slip back beneath the murmuring leaves. The choir resumes softly
behind you, apparently rehearsing until you return.

boss.revealText:
The Minnows scatter as an enormous silver-fin shape sweeps through the
clearing.

Chorus-Fin Schoolmother reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Chorus-Fin Schoolmother retreats into the whispering canopy.

The Minnows return to their roots, and the forest begins passing the
story of your victory from leaf to leaf.

By tomorrow, the fish will probably have exaggerated everything."
